text:
Elena (marcom): FYI - telemetry shows higher-than-normal embeddings latency in eu-west starting now. Need rapid comms plan: statuspage copy, email timing, and hold on promos.
Maya (growth): On it. Scope? Which customers/plans impacted?
Liam (ops): ~10-15% of embedding traffic, mostly Dedicated customers with small batch workloads. No data loss. Suspect network/NVLink bottleneck. Engineers shifting traffic; mitigation ETA 15-30m.
Elena (marcom): Proposed channel/timing:
- Status page + in-app banner: T+5m (public)
- Email to Dedicated/Enterprise: T+20m if still degraded
- Pause webinar reminder sends until resolved
- Wait to post on social until status page live
Maya (growth): Draft statuspage blurb: "We are investigating elevated latency for embedding requests in eu-west. Engineers are applying mitigations; no evidence of data loss. Updates every 30 minutes." Thoughts?
Elena (marcom): Good. Email subject options (soft vs direct): 1) "Service update: eu-west embeddings latency" 2) "Quick update: addressing higher latency in eu-west" — prefer #2.
Sam (sales): Please include escalation instructions for trial customers (priority@redwood.com + account ID). Also can CRM tag recent eu-west leads as "eu-west-latency"?
Maya (growth): Yes, will add tag and route MQLs > $5k to CSM queue. Pausing Mailer now.
ops-bot: incident/176430 created https://incidents.internal/r/176430 (auto-updates enabled).
ops-bot: Mitigation started; routing changes in progress.
Liam (ops): Tech note to incident: "NVLink congestion observed; draining hosts and scaling additional nodes."
ops-bot: Update: 3/4 affected hosts mitigated, latency trending down.
Elena (marcom): If stable at T+30m we can resume webinar reminders. Maya, approve final email copy after ops snap at T+10m.
Maya (growth): Will wait for ops confirmation. Also request: add a one-click "pause promotions" toggle in Mailer backlog item.
Liam (ops): Noted. Ill post when resolved and attach postmortem link.
ops-bot: Final: incident resolved. All systems normal. https://incidents.internal/r/176430/summary
Elena (marcom): Maya please publish final status and send follow-up email template to Sam for review. Sam, confirm CRM tagging applied.
Sam (sales): Tagging applied and routing rule live.
Elena (marcom): Closing thread. Postmortem invite to follow.
